compact_tables false (default) pads cells to column width

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"compact_tables\":false}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<table><thead><tr><th>Name</th><th>Score</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Alice</td><td>100</td></tr><tr><td>Bob</td><td>42</td></tr></tbody></table>", options)
    println(result)
}
```
